mentions.name: MedAngle
mentions.description: MedAngle is an invite-only, bootstrapped agentic AI super app for premed, medical, and dental students and recent graduates, personalized to their 4-6 year curriculum. It combines MedGPT, MedAgent, and Spaci (a spaced repetition system) layered over features such as quizzes, videos, notes, flashcards, reminders, scheduling, performance tracking, and search, organized into components like the Smart Suite, Learning Library, Clinical Corner, and Tested Tools. It reports 100k+ users.
mentions.audience: premed, medical, and dental students and recent graduates (young doctors)
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on MedAngle, the world's first Agentic AI Super App for premed, medical, and dental schools and recent graduates - young doctors.
